description: This file defines the EIT class within the Thunder::Broadcast::DVB namespace, representing the Event Information Table (EIT) for DVB broadcasting. It includes nested classes, constants, and methods for parsing and iterating over DVB EIT data structures, including service iteration and descriptor handling.

classes.name: EIT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Event Information Table, providing methods to access transport stream ID, original network ID, and iterate over services.

classes.name: EIT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within an EIT, providing methods to check validity, move to next service, and access service properties.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::ServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID of the current service.

methods.name: EIT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the services contained in the EIT.

methods.name: EIT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the EIT data.

methods.name: EIT::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the EIT.
